settings.privacy.network.title: Network activity
settings.privacy.recent.title: Recent activity
settings.privacy.recent.hint: The most recent trust-relevant actions, captured locally. No code, payloads, or share URLs are ever stored here.
settings.privacy.sensitiveHeaders.title: Sensitive HTTP headers
settings.privacy.networkPolicy.label: Network from running code
settings.privacy.networkPolicy.hint: Applies to the Worker, Pyodide and Ruby WASM runtimes by wrapping fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and EventSource while your code runs. Ask prompts once per host in each tab. Best effort, not a sandbox.
settings.privacy.networkPolicy.scope: Enforced for Worker · Pyodide · Ruby WASM. Node, Deno, Bun, Go, Rust and system Ruby on desktop run natively and fall under the native execution acknowledgement.
settings.privacy.aiSource.label: AI assistance source
settings.privacy.aiSource.hint: Where Explain this error, Explain this code and Ask SQL send their prompt. Lingua ships no default key or endpoint and sends nothing without an explicit Send.
settings.privacy.sensitiveHeaders.descri: Header names listed here are redacted in HTTP workspace history and on exported capsules. Baseline names always apply.
settings.privacy.privateHosts.title: Allow private HTTP targets
settings.privacy.privateHosts.descriptio: Let the desktop HTTP workspace reach localhost, LAN, and link-local hosts. Public targets stay guarded and every redirect is checked.
settings.privacy.privateHosts.webUnavail: Private-host access is controlled by the browser in the web build. Use Lingua Desktop for an explicit opt-in.
